categories.title: Fast Travel Door
categories.info: Unlock fast travel doors to travel between them.

categories.title: Map Pylon
categories.info: Activate the nearby map sensors and then activate this map kit to unlock the map for this district.

categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: An FBC structure that connects one part of the world to another.

categories.title: Player Customization
categories.info: A portable wardrobe that allows you to change customization and outfits.

categories.title: Ability Door
categories.info: An obstacle that can be cleared with a Combat Ability to open the way.

categories.title: Power Core Station
categories.info: Location of a Power Core Station where a charge can be collected.

categories.title: Orientation Point
categories.info: Approach an orientation point to activate it. Upon death, you will respawn here.

categories.title: Resonant Entity
categories.template: Defeating a resonant entity starts a new Resonant Cycle. This resets World Feats and respawns all enemies as tougher variants with better loot.

categories.title: Artifact
categories.template: Collect the blueprint for an artifact and then construct it within the Gap, then equip them in your loadout. Artifacts can be created more than once.

categories.title: Taskboard
categories.info: After saving Simon Arish, speak to Ranger Ruboneka at the Field Office to unlock FBC tasks, then visit Taskboards around the world to start new tasks.

categories.title: Taxi
categories.info: Enter each of the taxi cabs found in the world to progress through The Last Taxi side story.

categories.title: Paranatural Camera
categories.info: Paranatural Cameras are prone to freezing people and running away. Sneak up on them to capture them. The locations of Paranatural Cameras can be revealed by finding Instant Photos around the world.

categories.title: Instant Photo
categories.info: Instant Photos reveal the location of a Paranatural Camera somewhere in the world.

categories.title: FBC Testing Facility
categories.info: Complete the shutdown procedure at each FBC Testing Facility to complete the Unsupervised Science miniquest.

categories.title: Research Balloon
categories.info: Interact with the suspended platform to detach it from the balloon and then break open the crate to find the sensors. Take each sensor to the location indicated on your minimap to activate the research balloon.

categories.title: Sketchbook
categories.info: A piece from a sketchbook scene, completed by placing them together correctly.

categories.title: Arcade Cabinet
categories.info: Each arcade cabinet hosts a unique, replayable challange in SHÜM® III for you to master.

categories.title: Vending Machine
categories.info: Looks like an ordinary vending machine until struck, then flees. Catch it and destroy it for its loot.

categories.title: Large Health Element
categories.info: Large Health Elements found throughout the world restore a large, fixed amount of Health. They cannot be picked up while your Health is full.

categories.title: Command Charge
categories.info: Look for Command Charges in the environment and use them to trigger Command on enemies. These only appear once you have unlocked the Command ability.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Bout Guard
locations.description:
*Adds **+50%** **Power** recovery but Dylan takes **+20%** more damage.*

Wouldn't want to lose your teeth in a fight.

**Creates:** Bout Guard

**Source:** Reward for completing [The Complete Set](#loc=953843).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Fingerboard
locations.description:
*Adds **+25%** **Damage** and **Falter** while using a **Gravity Anomaly**.*

Jesse and I got one of these from a cereal box once.

**Creates:** Fingerboard

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953205) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 3).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Pickpocket's Tool
locations.description:
*The next **Combat Ability** after a **Perfect Dodge** costs no **Power**. This benefit doesn't stack.*

Just enough to scare someone out of their valuables.

**Creates:** Pickpocket's Tool

**Source:** Reward for completing [The Beginning](#loc=953846).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Lost Prescription
locations.description:
*Adds **+30%** chance to restore a small amount of **Health** after a **Perfect Dodge**.*

It's practically empty, I hope they had a refill.

**Creates:** Lost Prescription

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953205) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Practice Knot
locations.description:
*Adds **+15%** extra **Falter** to attacks on **Heavy enemies**.*

Knowing how to tie a good knot is the first step to becoming an expert survivalist.

**Creates:** Practice Knot

**Source:** Reward for completing [Crossing the Threshold](#loc=953862).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Medical Alert Bands
locations.description:
*Adds **+25%** **Falter** to all attacks when Dylan's **Health** is less than **25%**.*

I really hope no one is missing these…

**Creates:** Medical Alert Bands

**Source:**
- Reward for completing [Carbon Copy: Part II](#loc=953863).
- Reward for completing [Carbon Copy: Part III](#loc=953906).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Lighter
locations.description:
*Gives Dylan resistance to **Burn** by increasing the time it takes to get the status effect.*

Jesse and I once found a lighter and a pack of cigarettes. We nearly coughed our lungs out.

**Creates:** Lighter

**Source:** Reward for defeating [The Central Resonant](#loc=953866).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Stellar Bracelet
locations.description:
*When **Shield** is destroyed, it restores a small amount of **Health** but only when it's **broken**, not when it's cancelled.*

It fits my wrist perfectly.

**Creates:** Stellar Bracelet

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953206) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Feeding Bottle
locations.description:
*Adds **+30%** **Power** recovery. This benefit is applied while affected by **Infected** or **Burn**.*

Hopefully the parents had a backup bottle.

**Creates:** Feeding Bottle

**Source:** Reward for completing [Panopticon Service Request](#loc=953865).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Bug Spray
locations.description:
*Adds **+30%** **Damage** and **Falter** against **Mold** enemies. However, Dylan receives twice as much **Infected** build-up.*

Ordinary was always full of bugs in summer. The Oldest House sometimes got spiders.

**Creates:** Bug Spray

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953206) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 3).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Heart Monitor
locations.description:
*Prevents death and instantly regenerates **Health** to **+20%**. **Breaks** upon activation.*

The tool of someone who saved many lives. I hope their life was saved in turn.

**Creates:** Heart Monitor

**Source:** Reward for completing [Urban Survival](#loc=953889).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Ornate Buckle
locations.description:
***Executing** enemies recovers a large amount of **Power**. **Damage** taken is increased by **30%**.*

It's comically large, can anyone actually use this with a belt?

**Creates:** Ornate Buckle

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953207) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped World Tour Tickets
locations.description:
***Combat Abilities** deal **+100%** more **Damage**. **Power** is capped at **50%**.*

I'd love to go see them someday, hope they haven't retired.

**Creates:** World Tour Tickets

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953393) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Catnip Toy
locations.description:
*Significantly reduces damage from falling into the void.*

The smell is still strong, maybe it'll get strays to like me.

**Creates:** Catnip Toy

**Source:** Reward for completing [Into the Valley of Death](#loc=953890).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Mother's Locket
locations.description:
*Adds **+25%** **Damage** when **Health** is less than **25%**.*

Even if they're far away, a mother keeps their child close. My mother had one of these.

**Creates:** Mother's Locket

**Source:** Reward for completing [Carbon Copy](#loc=953905).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Face Mask
locations.description:
*Gives Dylan resistance to **Infected** by increasing the time it takes for him to get the status effect.*

Wearing one can protect you and others from all types of airborne illness.

**Creates:** Face Mask

**Source:** Reward for defeating [The Park Resonant](#loc=953908).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Brass Dusters
locations.description:
***Combat Abilities** deal **+50%** **Damage** but no **Falter** at all.*

You could do some real damage with these.

**Creates:** Brass Dusters

**Source:** Reward for completing [New Growth](#loc=953907).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Molding Bar
locations.description:
*Grants immunity to **Infected** and increases **Damage** and **Falter** against **Mold** enemies. Caps **Health** at **50%**.*

It's hard to resist eating it.

**Creates:** Molding Bar

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953208) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Badge 11-60
locations.description:
*Dylan takes significantly less damage from **Environmental Hazards**.*

The front of the badge says Fidelis Ad Mortem. Wonder what it means.

**Creates:** Badge 11-60

**Source:** Reward for completing [Orientation](#loc=953909).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Bar Blade
locations.description:
***Health** regenerates slowly while a **Summon** is nearby.*

It's basically being held together by that rubber band but still works like a charm.

**Creates:** Bar Blade

**Source:** Reward for completing [The Party Won’t Stop](#loc=953922).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Amulet
locations.description:
*Increases **Critical Chance** for all **Melee** attacks by **+5%**.*

I don't know if this blessing can erase all my worries, but I'll take all the help I can get.

**Creates:** Amulet

**Source:** Reward for defeating [The West Incursion Zone Resonant](#loc=953923).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Spray Paint
locations.description:
*Increases Dylan's **Blunt** **Damage** output by **15%**.*

Ordinary had some graffiti, but nothing like the stuff you see in New York.

**Creates:** Spray Paint

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953209) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Novelty Magnet
locations.description:
*Nearby small resource crates are marked on the **Radar**.*

These things are always way overpriced.

**Source:** 1st place reward from [Arcade Cabinet: Severed Circle 2](#loc=953948).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Paper Plane
locations.description:
*Increases **Power** for every attack Dylan does while airborne.*

I guess the articles weren't very interesting.

**Creates:** Paper Plane

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953210) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 3).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Wad of Cash
locations.description:
*Makes the **Command** ability cost **1** fewer **Command Charge**. Minimum cost is still **1**.*

$182, to be exact.

**Creates:** Wad of Cash

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953210) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Golden Earrings
locations.description:
*Boosts **Falter** by **+20%**. However, **Damage** is decreased by **-30%**.*

The stone in the center shines green and purple in the right light.

**Creates:** Golden Earrings

**Source:** Reward for defeating [The Underpass Resonant](#loc=953962).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Framing Hammer
locations.description:
***Combat Abilities** will deal **+30%** **Falter** but no **Damage** at all.*

A heavy duty hammer used for construction. Standard issue.

**Creates:** Framing Hammer

**Source:** Sold by the [Vendor](#loc=953211) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Old Subway Card
locations.description:
*Significantly increases **Rush** duration.*

I wonder if I can still use this, maybe find some of Jesse's favorite spots in the city.

**Creates:** Old Subway Card

**Source:** Reward for defeating the Hiss Collider Apex encounter.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Shiny Pebble
locations.description:
*Slowly restores **Health** up to **50%** while using a **Gravity Anomaly**.*

I used to love finding quartz and pretty stones to give to mom.

**Creates:** Shiny Pebble

**Source:** Reward for completing the Freeze Frame mini-quest chain.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Whetstone
locations.description:
*Add **+20%** **Damage** for all Melee attacks and Combat Abilities, but **Falter** will be reduced by **20%**.*

Dad had one of these too. He used it a lot to sharpen his hunting knife.

**Creates:** Whetstone

**Source:** Reward for completing A New Directive.

locations.title: Lit Sparkler
locations.description:
*A **Perfect Dodge** will cause Dylan's next **Dodge** to create an explosive charge, dealing **Fire** **Damage** to nearby enemies.*

Is this going to burn a hole in my pocket?

**Source:** Granted by the Downtown district upgrade "Artifact".

locations.title: Wallet
locations.description:
***Combat Abilities** consume **Health** when out of **Power**. **Health** cannot drop below **5%** from this Artifact.*

I should probably turn this in once this is over. I hope whoever it belongs to is still out there.

**Source:** Granted by the Central district upgrade "Artifact".

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Worn Eraser
locations.description:
*Gives Dylan significant resistance to all negative status effects by increasing the time it takes for them to build up.*

If only all mistakes were easy to undo.

**Creates:** Worn Eraser

**Source:** Reward for completing Fight to the Core.

locations.title: Energy Drink
locations.description:
*Adds **+30% Critical Chance** for all melee attacks when Dylan is at maximum **Health**. Dylan takes **+20%** more damage while this Artifact is equipped.*

Darling let me have one of these to see if it affected my abilities. My hands were shaking for hours.

**Source:** Granted by the Twisted City district upgrade "Artifact".

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Compact
locations.description:
***Critical Hits** deal **+50%** more **Damage**. However, they deal **30%** less **Falter**.*

I used to watch my mom put her makeup on all the time, before she stopped going out.

**Creates:** Compact

**Source:** 2nd reward for defeating The Unknown Resonant.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Coffee Cup
locations.description:
***Health** regenerates slowly outside of combat.*

I don't think I like coffee, but the researchers drank it all the time.

**Creates:** Coffee Cup

**Source:** Reward for completing the Last Taxi mini-quest chain.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Trusted Spanner
locations.description:
*Increases Dylan's **Raw** **Damage** output by **15%**.*

A wrench that's well worn and used.

**Creates:** Trusted Spanner

**Source:** Reward for completing the Notes: Every Dog Has Her Day mini-quest chain.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Fork
locations.description:
*Increases Dylan's **Sharp** **Damage** output by **15%**.*

Could be a pretty good weapon in a pinch.

**Creates:** Fork

**Source:** Reward for completing the Notes: Mapping the New New York mini-quest chain.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Scrunchie
locations.description:
*Increases **Damage** done by **Primary Melee** weapon forms by **10%**.*

Jesse had one just like this. She said it was lucky.

**Creates:** Scrunchie

**Source:** Reward for completing the Unsupervised Science mini-quest chain.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Weekend Crossword
locations.description:
*Increases **Damage** done by **Combo Finishers** by **+15%**.*

Grandma loved these, said they used to keep her mind sharp.

**Creates:** The Weekend Crossword

**Source:** Reward for completing the Zoe's Favorites mini-quest chain.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped Unfinished Lollipop
locations.description:
*Increases **Damage** done by **Secondary Melee** weapon forms by **10%**.*

Smells like apple and…blueberry?

**Creates:** Unfinished Lollipop

**Source:** Reward for completing the Sketchbook mini-quest chain.

locations.title: Blueprint: Untapped 1996 Commemorative Coin
locations.description:
***Health Elements** will become more effective and restore a larger amount **Health**.*

Minted for an occasion no one can quite remember.

**Creates:** 1996 Commemorative Coin

**Source:** Reward for defeating The Unknown Resonant.

locations.title: Welcome to Manhattan
locations.description:
*I've made a deal with the FBC. They let me out temporarily, and I help them fight. They never would have agreed if the situation wasn't desperate. Zoe will be my handler. She'll give me my first assignment.*

**Category:** Main Story: Contain the Crisis

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP
- 2nd: 1500x Source, 800 Zone XP

locations.title: Recursions and Iterations
locations.description:
*After the disaster with the CFD, the Sinkhole's been Patterned even deeper. Now Pope needs my help.*

**Category:** Main Story: Protect the Dimension

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard, 1x Prime Candidate Restraint Suit
- 2nd: 1500x Source
- 600 Zone XP each

locations.title: The Beginning
locations.description:
*My birth certificate has been re-issued and I'm officially an FBC consultant. I even have my own apartment in the city now. There's still a lot to do in Manhattan, but visiting Jesse comes first.*

**Category:** Main Story: Epilogue

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Untapped Pickpocket's Tool, 800 Zone XP
- 2nd: 1500x Source, 1200 Zone XP

locations.title: Power Lines
locations.description:
*The CFD needs a lot of power. A maintenance team was sent to reroute power from the city grid through the subway stations, but they disappeared, along with an entire subway station. Arish wants me to finish the job.*

**Category:** Main Story: Contain the Crisis

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP
- 2nd: 1500x Source, 750 Zone XP

locations.title: Evacuation Procedures
locations.description:
*After the Evac Site was overrun, Hiss tremors began emanating from the building. I need to find out what's going on so we can put a stop to it.*

**Category:** Main Story: Contain the Crisis

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard, 1x Agent Uniform
- 2nd: 1500x Source
- 600 Zone XP each

locations.title: Arish's Briefing
locations.description:
*Arish wants to see me in the Field Office. We couldn't stop the tremors at the Evac Site, but apparently he has a plan.*

**Category:** Main Story: Contain the Crisis

locations.title: Enemy of My Enemy
locations.description:
*The CFD is almost complete. But the tremors at the Evac Site are still getting worse. We're running out of time...*

**Category:** Main Story: Contain the Crisis

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard, 1x Bureau Rain Gear: Torn
- 2nd: 1500x Source
- 600 Zone XP each

locations.title: Into the Sinkhole
locations.description:
*The active Pattern resonance the CFD needs can be found at the bottom of the Sinkhole. We just have to harness it. But the team the FBC sent down to place the probe relays didn't get far. Hopefully I'll have better luck...*

**Category:** Main Story: Contain the Crisis

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard
- 2nd: 1500x Source
- 600 Zone XP each

locations.title: The Subway Fault
locations.description:
*Patterning in the Evacuation Zone's subway tunnels could lead me to another Fault. It's worth taking a look...*

**Category:** Main Story: Search for Jesse

**Rewards:**
- 1x Living Shard
- 600 Zone XP

locations.title: Orientation
locations.description:
*Something's gone wrong in the Oldest House. What did I wake up to?*

**Category:** Main Story: Wake Up

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 2000x Source, 1x Living Shard, 2x Reset Item, 1x Untapped Badge 11-60, 380 Zone XP
- 2nd: 2500x Source, 1x Reset Item, 800 Zone XP

locations.title: The House in Distress
locations.description:
*Somehow deep underground, I saw a vision: A Dimensional Fault inside the Oldest House. I asked Zoe to meet me at the entrance to the Prime Candidate training grounds. I don't think I can do this alone...*

**Category:** Main Story: Protect the Dimension

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP
- 2nd: 1500x Source, 1000 Zone XP

locations.title: The Hedron Link
locations.description:
*After the ritual was interrupted, the source of the Patterning entered our dimension: It's a Hedron, an extradimensional resonant force. It will Pattern everything it finds, starting with the Oldest House. Unless I stop it.*

**Category:** Main Story: Protect the Dimension

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP
- 2nd: 1500x Source, 1000 Zone XP

locations.title: The Incursion Fault
locations.description:
*The West Incursion Zone is full of Patterning. Something's going on there, even beyond the chaotic state the rest of the city is in...*

**Category:** Main Story: Search for Jesse

**Rewards:**
- 1st: 1x Living Shard
- 2nd: 1500x Source
- 600 Zone XP each

locations.title: Sever the Hedron Links
locations.description:
*After destroying the first Hedron Link, two more slammed into the Patterned city above the Oldest House. I'll disrupt the Pattern and sever both. Then I'll go after the Hedron itself.*

**Category:** Main Story: Defeat the Hedron

**Solution:** ||

locations.title: Taxi

2. The lights on the taxis are blinking. Enter the taxi that is out-of-sync with the rest.

locations.title: Taxi
locations.description:
**Solution:** ||
1. Reach the payphone and talk to Mila.
2. Break the mold spores around the taxi to find the missing parts and bring them to the taxi, then enter the taxi.
3. Repeat step 2, some parts do not belong to the taxi this time. Enter the taxi once reassembled.
4. Defeat the 3 smaller spores hidden in the mold, then the larger spore on-top of the taxi. Once clear, find the correct parts for the taxi to reassemble it and enter the taxi for a third and final time.
||

||

||

locations.title: Sketchbook: Rooftop Oasis
locations.description: Arrange the [Bird Statue](#loc=953830), [Bird Statue](#loc=953831), [Bird Statue](#loc=953832), [Potted Plant](#loc=953833), [Potted Plant](#loc=953834) and [Potted Plant](#loc=953835) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Atlantis Cafe Secret Room
locations.description:
**Solution:** ||Turn the power breaker on and then switch on each appliance in order of size. 

1. Radio (opposite side of the room)
2. Coffee Machine
3. Bigger Coffee Machine
4. Soda Dispenser
5. Microwave
6. Fridge

Once complete, a secret entrance will open.||

locations.title: Sketchbook: Beach Day
locations.description: Arrange the [Camping Chair](#loc=953838) and [Umbrella](#loc=953839) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Secret: Laundry Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:** Each horizontal row on the [Laundry Puzzle](#loc=951649) note corresponds to a row of washing machines, starting from the east wall and moving west.

Turn the washing machines on (1) or off (0) depending on the number shown on the grid. As soon as the correct combination is activate, a secret wall will open in the back room.

locations.title: Sketchbook: The Cat Picnic
locations.description: Arrange the [Black Cat Statue](#loc=953851), [Picnic Basket](#loc=953850) and [Ginger Cat Statue](#loc=953852) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Sketchbook: Live on Stage
locations.description: Arrange the [Cymbal](#loc=953855), [Bass Guitar](#loc=953856), [Guitar](#loc=953857), [Keyboard](#loc=953858) and [Microphone](#loc=953859) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Charlie Beecham Art Gallery
locations.description:
Inside the art gallery there's a note [Paintings Sold](#loc=951738). There are four sets of paintings each with a light switch to toggle which one is illuminated. You need to light the paintings that best match the words on the note.

Solution: ||Facing the reception desk from the door.

- Left Wall: Middle painting
- Front Right Wall: Middle painting
- Back Right Wall: Left painting
- Back Wall: Left painting
||

locations.title: Sketchbook: Robotics
locations.description: Arrange the [Robot Arm](#loc=953875), [Robot Leg](#loc=953876), [Robot Arm](#loc=953877), [Robot Leg](#loc=953878) and [Spotlight](#loc=953879) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Sketchbook: Dream House
locations.description: Arrange the [Plywood Wall](#loc=953881), [Potted Plant](#loc=953882), [Planter](#loc=953883), [Cat Statue](#loc=953884), [Dog Statue](#loc=953885) and [Plywood Roof](#loc=953886) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Sketchbook: The Dragon and The Knight Sketch
locations.description:
**Location:** On the station platform of the Park Valley subway.

Arrange the [Traffic Cone](#loc=953895), [Traffic Cone](#loc=953896), [Pizza Slice](#loc=953897), [Pizza Slice](#loc=953898), [Fence Cover](#loc=953899) and [Fence Cover](#loc=953900) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Atlantis Cafe Secret Basement
locations.description:
**Solution:** ||Check the four tables listed on the [Table reservations](#loc=951762) list and then check each of those tables in order.

The menu on each table corresponds to an item on the [Coffee menu](#loc=951763). Enter this combination on the cash register to open the secret wall.||

locations.title: Urban Fresh Mart Secret Door
locations.description:
**Solution:** ||
1. Activate the soda dispenser
2. Remember order of lights blinking (3-1-2-1)
3. Reverse code (1-2-1-3)
4. Activate cash register and enter the code
||

locations.title: Sketchbook: Halloween Party
locations.description: Arrange the [Ghost](#loc=953916), [Pumpkins](#loc=953917), [Inflatable](#loc=953918) and [Skeleton](#loc=953919) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Pulse Fitness Secret Basement
locations.description:
**Solution:** ||Based on the [Workout Instructions](#loc=951874), follow this sequence:

1. Set the treadmill speed to 0.5 mph.
2. Set the spin bike speed to 15 mph.
3. Take a snack from the vending machine.
4. Set the treatmill speed to 15 mph.
5. Set the spin bike speed to 0.5 mph.

Once done in the correct order, a secret wall will open near the spin bike.||

locations.title: Sketchbook: Art Exhibition
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the KÖNSTIG art gallery.

Arrange the [Metal Ball](#loc=953927), [Laptop](#loc=953928), [Toilet](#loc=953929) and [Vacuum Cleaner](#loc=953930) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Sketchbook: Game Night
locations.description: Arrange the [Figurine](#loc=953934), [Figurine](#loc=953935), [Candlestick](#loc=953936), [Pizza](#loc=953937), [Mannequin](#loc=953938) and [Figurine](#loc=953939) in the correct order to complete.

locations.title: Sketchbook: Space Adventure
locations.description: Arrange the [Astronaut Figurine](#loc=953952), [Astronaut Figurine](#loc=953953), [Flag](#loc=953954), [Alien Figurine](#loc=953955) and [Spaceship](#loc=953956) in the correct order to complete.
